discrepancies.finding: April2026 US label includes CSU age2 and older despite H1 therapy. Guideline pediatric text still describes dupilumab trials and omalizumab as the only approved biologic. Use current indication-specific label.
discrepancies.resolution: Draft age/weight-specific dosing; do not transfer asthma or eczema eligibility to CSU.

discrepancies.finding: Book permits bedtime first-generation use and commonly prescribed hydroxyzine. Current guideline recommends against routine first-generation treatment; bedtime does not eliminate next-day impairment.
discrepancies.resolution: Preserve historical/labeled hydroxyzine dose as context, teach QT, anticholinergic and sedation risks and second-generation preference.

discrepancies.finding: Book describes benefit in some patients.2026 guideline cannot recommend for or against H1 plusH2 in chronic urticaria; not a standard escalation step.
discrepancies.resolution: Explain uncertain adjunct role without claiming proven ineffectiveness.

discrepancies.finding: Remibrutinib and dupilumab US CSU approvals postdate source book.
discrepancies.resolution: Add original targeted-therapy lessons with eligibility, dose, technique and safety.

discrepancies.finding: General rash advice adjacent to urticaria cannot be applied to all hives. Guideline does not support routine topical corticosteroids for urticaria or long-term systemic/depot treatment.
discrepancies.resolution: Distinguish short clinician-selected rescue from maintenance and do not import poison-plant taper plans.

discrepancies.finding: US label150or300mg every4weeks vs guideline initial300mg every4weeks; CSU dose independent of weight/IgE.
discrepancies.resolution: State labeled options and guideline preference separately; escalation beyond label is specialist/off-label.
